root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from a double free of the device tree node reference in `rockchip_usb2phy_probe()`, where the error handling path redundantly calls `of_node_put()` after the `for_each_available_child_of_node` macro has already released the reference during loop exit.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that "After breaking from the loop with the child_np has been released, the code will jump to the put_child label and will call the of_node_put() again," and the patch fixes this by changing the control flow from `goto put_child;` to `return ret;` to bypass the duplicate release.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement is vulnerable because it calls of_node_put() on child_np after the for_each_available_child_of_node macro has already released the reference during loop exit. When the loop breaks or completes, the macro automatically decrements the reference count. Any subsequent explicit of_node_put() call on the same node pointer causes a double-free vulnerability, which can lead to use-after-free and potential code execution.
